description: Corrected provenance copy of the HHC リキッド (product term) YouTube run. The handover document remains 20261101-youtube-hhc-liquid-cannabinoid-raw-collection.json and its bytes are unchanged; this copy records the current actor input vocabulary, a portable handover reference, and the evidence state without rewriting the original. It is not a re-staging document: the run id already exists and staging it again must fail closed. The HHC compound-term run is retained provenance outside this study's liquid-only primary coverage; it is not a required companion.

runs.purpose: Owner-requested HHC リキッド YouTube collection for this study's liquid-only primary coverage.

collection_request.actor_input_basis: Owner correction 2026-11-01 (exact actor input vocabulary and the 0 limits) plus the original declaration, which recorded the limit 500 under the previous actor's max_videos key. The export's input column is 'HHC リキッド' for all 412 records and its type column is 'video' for all 412; neither is proof of the input values, but both are consistent with them.
collection_request.date_filter_basis: No dateFilter was supplied to the actor. 'all' is the declaration vocabulary for the unbounded request (src/collection/adapters/youtube/apify_csv.py DATE_FILTERS); the actor itself has no 'all' value.

temporal.boundary_semantics: Observed video publish-date range in the payload, normalized to a half-open UTC day interval; not the API condition and not a request window.
limitations: The request had no dateFilter and therefore no absolute publish-date window; the search was unbounded as far as the actor input states.
window.start is the earliest observed video publish date at 00:00:00Z and window.end_exclusive is one day after the latest observed publish date; both are derived from returned items only.
The actor returns a search-result sample, not a census. The payload does not establish whether further matching videos existed.
The run is not country-limited by an API geo filter. The Japanese product term リキッド approximates a Japanese-market restriction through query language; this is not a geographic guarantee.

timestamps.basis: Actor run 4Eaqb2cab6K10tpxL as reported in the original handover declaration; the Apify run status object itself is not in this checkout.

environment.actor_build_note: Neither the original declaration nor the export records a build id. Do not infer it from the HHC compound run; retrieve it from the Apify run detail (ISS-20261015-PRV-013).

execution_evidence.final_run_status_note: The Apify final run status object is not available offline. Corroborate it through ISS-20261015-PRV-013 before treating the status as verified.
execution_evidence.partial_result_note: 412 records returned against the recorded maxResults 500; the payload does not establish whether further matches existed.
